subject.title: fix(sqlite): normalize BLOB/TEXT type mismatches during STRICT migration

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this fail-closed upgrade policy for BLOB/TEXT values that collide after canonical key normalization, rather than provide an automatic or Doctor-mediated conflict resolution path?
rationale: The choice determines whether an existing persisted database remains blocked on an ambiguous collision, is repaired through a user-visible recovery flow, or risks data loss; code review cannot safely choose that product and data-recovery policy.

options.title: Approve fail-closed normalization
options.body: Accept CAST normalization for unambiguous rows and require explicit operator recovery for normalized key collisions, preserving every conflicting record.

options.title: Require a Doctor recovery design
options.body: Keep normalization but add a maintainer-approved, non-destructive Doctor recovery workflow before landing collision handling.

options.title: Defer collision behavior
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the durable persisted-key conflict contract for upgrades.

recommendation.title: Require a Doctor recovery design
recommendation.body: Keep normalization but add a maintainer-approved, non-destructive Doctor recovery workflow before landing collision handling.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged change established the STRICT migration and its upgrade-safety boundary.
